learner_operation: For each offered coordinate set, mentally zero exactly those entries, locate each remaining row leading entry, check strictly increasing leading columns and bottom-only zero rows; select the unique successful offered operation.

fixed_features.feature: Ordinary four-by-four integer matrix, five radio choices, entry replacement by zero.
fixed_features.justification: All 15 captured practice items share this workload and response contract. No row arithmetic, augmented-matrix interpretation or global optimization is introduced.

fixed_features.feature: Fresh operations name two or three coordinates and retain at least two nonzero rows from at least three initially nonzero rows.
fixed_features.justification: All captured keys name two or three coordinates and involve multirow inspection. These bounds preserve that workload. Already-zero and redundant named entries are legal; the explicit replay/parameter interface retains complete source banks.
The source radio banks require an unambiguous offered response; globally unique or minimum erasures are unnecessary.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any of five coordinate sets with a mathematical witness.
answer_roles.observed: Four fresh banks, conditional on two/three named entries and preexisting bottom zero row, independently admit every key position. Twenty visible matrix witnesses were generated and graded.

answer_roles.role: Coordinates removed versus retained leading entries.
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Alter zero structure to shift pivots or create bottom zero rows without changing the two echelon conditions.
answer_roles.observed: The controlled two-cell change moves the conflict from a21 to a31 and switches the fixed-bank key; fresh samples vary masks and erasure targets.

answer_roles.role: Named coordinate count, signs, magnitudes and option position.
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Source keys have two or three coordinates; nonzero values and order can vary independently of echelon status.
answer_roles.observed: Both fresh count cases and bottom-zero cases occur. All nonzero values -9 through 9 are represented in controls; source profiles retain mixed-size banks. Native UI display positions vary.

coverage.case: Complete original banks and source solution transformations.
coverage.result: All 15 source banks and keys match; their worked transformations match. Canonical operation checked, but no canonical answer bank was captured.

coverage.case: Two/three named coordinates, with/without a preexisting bottom zero row.
coverage.result: All four recognizable groups have five independently enumerated successful roles within the same fixed bank.

Five exact seeds replay; all survive delivery. Median strategy scores 0/5. No tested single label/order/position strategy answers the entire batch; observed small conditional groups are not claimed to establish population rates.

counterfactuals.change: Hold the complete bank and all other entries fixed; set a21 from 2 to 0 and a31 from 0 to 2.
counterfactuals.expected: The sole successful set switches from {a21,a43} to {a31,a43}; prompt matrices, explanation and grader follow it.
counterfactuals.observed: Independent visible-coordinate tests, native grading of all five answers, rendered before/after prompts and solutions agree.
counterfactuals.justification: Moving the conflicting leading entry changes which offered erasure restores increasing pivot columns.

counterfactuals.change: Hold zero structure and full bank fixed; replace a11=1 by -2.
counterfactuals.expected: All offered validity outcomes and the selected operation remain unchanged. The displayed number and worked matrix update.
counterfactuals.observed: Answer remains {a21,a43}; independent validation, native grader outcomes and actual UI render confirm the response preservation.
counterfactuals.justification: The lesson defines leading entries by zero/nonzero position; a nonzero magnitude/sign change cannot alter pivot columns.

counterfactuals.change: Keep each of four sampled banks fixed and vary matrix zero structure to realize each of its five successful roles.
counterfactuals.expected: Every role is mathematically possible and each new visible instance has precisely the corresponding accepted option.
counterfactuals.observed: Independent enumeration supplies 20 complete records; all five choices of each are checked by the native grader. Representative changed-role renders agree.
counterfactuals.justification: Source objects satisfying the echelon rule are eligible to change; a source-specific coordinate assignment is not an invariant.
